title: Smallest Pair With Different Frequencies
summary: Given an integer array, find the pair of distinct values where the first value is the smallest and the second value has a different frequency than the first.
statement: Given an integer array, find the pair of distinct values where the first value is the smallest and the second value has a different frequency than the first. If no such pair exists, return [-1, -1].
constraints: Choose two distinct values having different occurrence frequencies.
Minimize the first value, then minimize the second value under that first choice.
Return the pair, or [-1,-1] if no such values exist.
hints: Nested scanning in sorted order tests candidate pairs lexicographically.
Return the first pair with unequal counts, or the sentinel if none exists.
editorial: Return the first pair with unequal counts, or the sentinel if none exists.

tests.explanation: One is the smallest value; three is the smallest value with a different frequency.
Both distinct values have equal frequency, so no pair exists.
